definitions.explanation: Having a large diameter or girth.

examples.japanese: {太|ふと}いペンで{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write with a thick pen.

notes:
{太|ふと}い describes thickness or girth.

OPPOSITE: {細|ほそ}い (thin, slender)

COMMON USES:
- {足|あし}が{太|ふと}い (thick legs)
- {太|ふと}い{声|こえ} (deep/loud voice)
- {太|ふと}{字|じ} (bold text)

NOTE: For people's weight, {太|ふと}っている is more common.
